title: Escala component intent
description: Hand-written, owner-approved half of a component's contract: what it is for, what it is not for, who may change each state, and its accessibility promises. The generated contract (spec/contracts/<Key>.json) says what the component IS; this file says what it is FOR. Never generated, never merged into spec/contracts.

component.description: PascalCase key, identical to the Figma set and the spec/contracts key.

purpose.description: One or two sentences: the job this component does and when to reach for it.

notFor.description: Situations where this component is the wrong choice, each pointing to the right one.

use.description: An existing Escala component key, or 'none' when no component should be used.

states.description: Every state the component can be in, keyed by the state name used in the contract.

setBy.description: user = the person interacting; app = the product code using the component; both = either; component = the component itself (hover, focus-visible).

visual.description: What changes on screen, or exactly 'NOT DECIDED' when no treatment has been designed.

openQuestions.description: Everything marked NOT DECIDED above, written as a question for the owner.
